# Arcade Cabinet

Six games: Stellar Defense (11 by 5 formation, 4 destructible shields, one shot at a time), Asteroid Hunter (inertia ship, wrapping screen, splitting rocks, risky hyperspace, bonus saucer), Crossing (5-lane road then river on logs and turtles, 5 homes to fill), Galactic Hunter (diving enemies, tractor-beam capture, recoverable double ship), Maze Muncher (maze, pellets, 4 ghosts with distinct behaviors, power pellets and the 200, 400, 800, 1600 chain), Maze Frenzy (another maze, moving fruit, more random ghosts).

Controls: keyboard and touch, with touch buttons just below the game screen, visible together with the game, no scrolling.

Honesty: these games play in the browser from the link, not inside Muse itself. Muse shares the link, explains the rules and controls, and can keep your score in chat if you tell it. Best scores are saved in the browser, per device and per site domain. They do not follow you to another device. No world leaderboard, no cloud saves, no multiplayer.

Inspired games only: faithful mechanics, but original names, visuals and sounds, not the brands, characters or music of the original arcade games.
